title: Semmelweis Ignác and Childbed Fever: Degree Adverbs
grammar: Degree adverbs for the size of a change
goal: I can say how big a change was with a degree adverb (*számottevően*, *drasztikusan*, *csaknem*).
I can say what the text about Semmelweis Ignác tells about Vienna in 1847.
I can name the ideas of the discovery (*korszakalkotó áttörés*, *nyílt levél*, *halálozási arány*).
